g.text: RESTAURANT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM — LOW LEVEL DESIGN (CLASS DIAGRAM)
Complete Object-Oriented Architecture with Design Patterns (Facade & Command) and Concurrency Blueprint
Restaurant(name: String, menu: Menu, layout: Layout)
findAvailableTimeSlots(start: LocalDateTime, end: LocalDateTime, size: int): LocalDateTime[]
createScheduledReservation(partyName: String, size: int, time: LocalDateTime): Reservation
removeReservation(partyName: String, size: int, time: LocalDateTime): void
getName(): String | getMenu(): Menu | getLayout(): Layout
MenuItem(name: String, desc: String, price: BigDecimal, cat: Category)
findAvailableTimeSlots(start: LocalDateTime, end: LocalDateTime, size: int): LocalDateTime[]
createReservation(name: String, size: int, time: LocalDateTime): Reservation
removeReservation(name: String, size: int, time: LocalDateTime): boolean
Reservation(name: String, size: int, time: LocalDateTime, table: Table)
• Central simplified front door into subsystems
• Completely stateless: owns NO internal maps/sets
• Pure delegation to Domain Managers & Tables
• Encapsulates state actions: SendToKitchen, Deliver, Cancel
• Invoker: OrderManager queues and drains commands FIFO
• Receiver: OrderItem enforces state transition guards
• Table Orders: ConcurrentHashMap + atomic compute/computeIfPresent per MenuItem
• OrderManager: ConcurrentLinkedQueue with atomic poll() drain loop
